# The cksum ("<crc> <bytes>") of every file in a skill folder, command, agent and hook handler
# Agent Blueprint shipped from its first release to v3.8.0, with carriage returns removed first.
# detect-v3.sh removes a file found by its v3 name, or a skill folder, only when the file's (every
# file's, for a folder) cksum is listed here; another pack's file of the same name, a copy someone
# edited, or a file someone added to a skill folder is not. v3 is finished, so the list does not
# grow. Made in a full clone of the blueprint repository with
#   export LC_ALL=C
#   p='^([.]claude|plugins/claude-code-blueprint)/(skills/[^/]+/.+|(agents|commands)/[^/]+[.]md)$|^([.]claude/hooks|plugins/claude-code-blueprint/hooks/handlers)/[^/]+$'
#   git rev-list v3.8.0 | while read -r c; do git ls-tree -r "$c"; done | awk -F'\t' -v p="$p" '$2 ~ p { split($1, f, " "); print f[3] }' |
#       sort -u | while read -r blob; do git cat-file -p "$blob" | tr -d '\r' | cksum; done | sort -u
